description:
Surfaced during Arc 14 regression check.

Repro: from inside a project directory, run `./install.sh --target project --project-dir . --dry-run`. The plan reports `CAPTAIN suffix : __ (slug: _)` and would deploy files like `CAPTAIN_DAEDALUS__.md`.

Cause: install.sh:223 computes `PROJECT_SLUG="$(basename "$PROJECT_DIR" | tr '.-' '__')"`. When `PROJECT_DIR="."`, `basename "."` returns `.`, then `tr` converts the dot to `_`. The expected slug would be the actual containing-directory name (e.g., `widget_builder`).

Concrete fix: resolve the path before basename:
`PROJECT_SLUG="$(basename "$(cd "$PROJECT_DIR" && pwd)" | tr '.-' '__')"`

Affects ONBOARDING.md scenarios 1 + 2 (both teach `--project-dir .`); the rendered output in those scenarios shows the expected slug (`widget_builder`, `agent_character_builder`) which masks the bug. Scope-deferred from Arc 14 to keep that diff focused on sub-project work; pick this up as a small standalone fix-up.

comments.text: Fixed at commit 2dee8a0. Resolved --project-dir to absolute path before basename so '.' produces the actual containing-directory name. Smoke-verified: --project-dir . from inside widget-builder/ now produces _widget_builder suffix (was __). Absolute-path and relative-subdir forms unchanged; subproject mode unaffected.

title: [BUG] install.sh project mode: --project-dir . produces slug '_' instead of the actual basename
